messages:
nina: quick async — what I did / blockers / today

• Done: wired a canary header 'x-rw-canary' into the auth policy so we can route 5% -> new-policy. pushed a config bump to staging.

• Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s in the synthetic load that look like tiny-client bursts (short seq, lots of connections). not sure if it's burst handling or kv-cache priming.

• Today: tune token-bucket for short requests, add more logging around kv-cache priming, and open the PR for the routing rollout.

david: saw the 429 flakiness earlier. are the bursts coming from the same IPs / clients or from many sources?

nina: looks like many ephemeral clients (mobile SDK QA). logs: small payloads, high conn churn. will try lowering weight for <200b requests.

liam: fwiw, we had a similar pattern in edge last month. lowering the per-request cost helped; also raised burst window. snippet we used:

```
rate_bucket:
  refill_per_sec: 10
  capacity: 120
  short_req_weight: 0.2
```

liam: consider also adding a short warmup KV cache pass on first connect to avoid KV miss storm. small delay + prefetch.

serena: posted a quick canary policy draft in the PR comments. key point: fallback to older policy on 5xx or if avg latency > 200ms over 1m. Also added metric tags: route=mobile-sdk, canary=true.

nina: thanks — link to PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/412|PR #412> (contains policy json + rollout playbook).

deploy-bot: canary deploy triggered: staging -> canary (5%). checks: smoke=pass, svc-errs=0.2% (ok), lat_p95=120ms.

anna: quick question — when you bump the short_req_weight, do we need to update billing/tokens calc? i.e., will that change cost telemetry?

liam: it affects internal cost proxies only; token accounting for customers unchanged. but internal cost dashboards that normalize by request weight will shift — I'll add a note to infra-costs doc.

serena: no blockers from my side. will monitor metrics and add a synthetic that mimics the ephemeral mobile traffic.

nina: plan: apply token-bucket tweak to staging now, run synthetic for 30m, then if green open rollout to 10%. will ping here with results.

david: thanks — if you want a hand with the synthetic harness or the logs parsing, I can pair for 30min after lunch.

nina: appreciated, will DM to sync. :thumbsup:

anna: LGTM on the PR comments, will wait for the 30m smoke before approving. :eyes:
